{{Hatnote|This page is the tournament format. For the card, see [[The Bith Shuffle]].}}
'''The Bith Shuffle''' is a constructed side event in the [[Players Committee]]'s ''Alternate Format Tournament Guide'' (revised September 2015): at the start of every game each player is randomly given another player's deck from the main event.<ref name="afg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Star Wars CCG Alternate Format Tournament Guide] (revised 09/2015), Players Committee. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195355/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Type:''' constructed (consolation event)
* '''Defined by:''' Players Committee (Alternate Format Tournament Guide, 2015)
* '''Card pool:''' the decks played in the main event
* '''In use:''' listed in 2015
* '''GEMP:''' none

== Card pool ==
The guide's rules:<ref name="afg" />
* It can be held as a "consolation event" during larger tournaments.
* Each player brings exactly the same decks, including Defensive Shields, that they played in the main event. This "helps ensure the legitimacy or playability" of the decks.
* Pairings are made as in a normal Swiss event, but at the start of every game each player is randomly assigned a deck from another player at the event. Decks are not assigned based on the opponent.
* A player never plays their own deck, and never plays the same deck twice. Players hold on to their own decks between games.
* Players are encouraged to shout questions across the room to their deck's owner, such as "how many ships are in this deck".

== History ==
The guide lists The Bith Shuffle under "Alternate Tournament Formats" with [[Team Tournament Formats|team events]].<ref name="afg" /> No event in this format is recorded on this wiki.
